name: phone_action
unavailable: This needs the LLeMbas app on the person's phone, and this message did not come from it: nothing was done on any phone. Say what you would have done, and that they can ask again from the app.
description:
Do something on the person's phone: they are writing to you from the LLeMbas app on it, and the app carries it out with the phone's own apps. The person confirms every call on the phone before anything happens; the result says done, declined or failed, with what the phone said.

Use it only for what the person asked for, one action per call. `summary` is the one line the phone shows them: say what will happen, in their language.

- alarm: `time` (HH:MM, 24-hour); `days` to repeat it; `label`.
- timer: `seconds`; `label`.
- calendar_event: `title`, `start` (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, the phone's local time; YYYY-MM-DD with all_day); `end`, `all_day`, `location`, `notes`.
- sms_draft: `to` (numbers, or names as the person said them), `body`. A draft: the person sends it.
- email_draft: `to`, `cc`, `subject`, `body`. A draft: the person sends it.
- dial: `number`. Opens the dialer with it; the person places the call.
- navigate: `destination`; `stops` on the way, in order; `mode` (drive, walk, bike, transit); `replace_route` to start over rather than ask.
- add_stop: `stop`, and `destination` — the route's destination as the person told you. Keep the destination of a route you started: no map app can add to a running route, so the phone plans again to the stop and then the destination.
- search_nearby: `query` ("petrol station"), `near` me or the route.
- stop_navigation: ends the route. Not every map app can; the phone says so if not.
- open_app: `app`, as the person names it.
- open_url: `url` (http or https).
- media: `command` (play, pause, toggle, next, previous) for what is playing.
- torch: `on`.
- settings_panel: `panel` — the phone's quick panel or page for it; the person flips the switch.
- automation_intent: `task`, the name of an automation the person made (Tasker by default, or `app`); `values` it is given.

A place is lat and lon when you know them, else a `query` the map app searches; `name` is what the person calls it.

Declined means they said no on the phone: do not try again unless they ask. Failed says why; nothing was done.

summary.description: One line the phone shows the person: what will happen

label.description: alarm, timer: its name on the phone

start.description: calendar_event: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, local; YYYY-MM-DD with all_day

to.description: sms_draft: numbers or names; email_draft: addresses

destination.description: navigate, add_stop: where the route ends

name.description: What the person calls it: "Home", "Lidl on Main Street"

query.description: What the map app searches when there are no coordinates

items.description: A place: lat and lon when you know them, else a query the map app searches (an address, or a name and a town); name is what the person calls it

name.description: What the person calls it: "Home", "Lidl on Main Street"

query.description: What the map app searches when there are no coordinates

stops.description: navigate: places on the way, in order

name.description: What the person calls it: "Home", "Lidl on Main Street"

query.description: What the map app searches when there are no coordinates

mode.description: navigate: how the person travels (drive when not said)

replace_route.description: navigate: replace a route already running without asking

near.description: search_nearby: around the person, or along the running route
